newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico cattle report, feeder export price - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico cattle report, feeder export price - USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Wednesday that around 2,650 head were exported to the United States at three crossing points Tuesday.
Through Santa Teresa, New Mexico, around 2,200 steer calves sold weak to 1 cent/lb lower than last week. "Trade moderate, demand moderate," USDA said.
Prices for animals weighing 300-400 lb were 92-102 cents/lb and for 400-500 lb head at 82-92 cents/lb.
Through Del Rio, Texas, around 200 head were sold, although not enough to establish trend or quote prices.
Through Laredo, Texas around 250 head were sold, although again not enough to establish market trend prices.
